title: Readiness 4 · Generic through tracker
prompt: Write firstOr<T>(items, fallback): return the first item when the list is nonempty, even if it is 0 or empty text, and the fallback otherwise. Write summaries(tasks): return { id, title } for each open task (done is false), in order, with no other fields. The two must work together: firstOr(summaries(tasks), fallback).
hints: Use the list length, not truthiness, to decide whether a first item exists.
Filter open tasks, then build a new object with only id and title.
checks: __same(summaries([{ id: "a", title: "A", done: false, owner: "s" }, { id: "b", title: "B", done: true }]), [{ id: "a", title: "A" }])
__same(firstOr(summaries([{ id: "c", title: "", done: false }]), { id: "-", title: "none" }), { id: "c", title: "" })

wrongAnswers.misconception: Copies every field of each task.

feedback: Check an empty list, a falsy first item, and that summaries contain only the requested fields.
